metadata.title: Chip stocks fall, with Nvidia shares under heavy selling pressure - MarketWatch

content.text:
10 min ago
Chip stocks fall, with Nvidia shares under heavy selling pressure
Chip stocks were down Thursday morning, with investors dumping shares of Nvidia after the semiconductor company announced the resignation of its chief executive, Jensen Huang.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was down more than 1%, according to FactSet data, at last check. Shares of Nvidia, whose chips have been a central part of the artificial-intelligence race, were slumping more than 7% in Thursday morning trading.
